Commercial Terms

Partnership framework and full asset schedule · 2027-2028

Partnership Framework

Term2 yearS
Two-year partnership (2027-2028).
  • January 1, 2027 – December 31, 2027
  • January 1, 2028 – December 31, 2028
Franchises & Events
  • Sixteen (16) MMA Events
  • Six (6) Boxing Events
Territories
Global
Category Exclusivity
1xBet is the exclusive global betting partner across all MVP Events (except Africa) for the full Term. MVP will not sell the betting category on any MVP Event to a third party in this scope. MVP will not grant betting category rights on any MVP Event to a third party within this scope. US prediction markets and US social casino are excluded from the category.
Financial Commitment
  • 2027: $6,000,000 
  • 2028: $6,300,000

Partnership Assets

01

Trademark Rights & Official Designations

  • Use of MVP official marks across all marketing platforms
  • ‘Exclusive Global Betting Partner of MVP’ or other mutually agreed designation
  • Non-exclusive designations: ‘Official Partner of MVP’
02

Broadcast Integrations

  • Custom broadcast opportunities per event: promotional billboards, lower thirds, Fight Presenter and Tale of the Tape graphics, live odds integration
  • Applies at all Events
  • All of the above subject to approvals with each regional broadcaster
03

VIRTUAL OVERLAY

  • Where physical canvas branding isn't allowed, MVP will commit to virtual overlay branding for broadcast purposes:
  • 1 × large canvas
  • 1 × inner middle canvas 
  • 1 × vertical bumper
04

In-Arena Branding

  • 1 × large canvas
  • 1 × vertical bumper
  • 1 × horizontal bumper
  • 1 × external vertical bumper
  • LED screen branding throughout arena
05

Presenting Partner 1x MMA EVENT

  • 1xBet to be awarded Presenting Partner status of one (1) MMA event each year
  • Event marketing & promotion: 1xBet featured and tagged (where appropriate) as presenting partner across all pre-event marketing and promotion — e.g. ‘MVP Belfast presented by 1xBet’
  • In-Arena additions:
    • 1 ×  Centre Canvas position
    • 1xBet-branded LED wristbands in the arena for all attendees
    • Multiple brand audio reads from announcer throughout the night
    • 1 × Concourse activation booth
  • Additional broadcast integrations:
    • Virtual Presenting Partner canvas overlay, via TGI
    • Logo and audio recognition as presenting partner on the show title card open
    • Two (2) ‘Welcome Back Bumpers’ returning from commercial break, with graphical overlay
    • 1xBet presentation of main card fights
    • 1xBet mark on the Fight Clock for the first thirty (30) seconds of Main and Co-Main Events
06

Social Content Distribution

  • 12 × short form social series per year
  • 2 × fight week series
  • All soical posts to be agreed in advance
  • Logo inclusion and tag of 1xBet on each post
07

MVP Betting Hub

  • Dedicated 1xBet-branded Betting Hub on the MVP website, designed and built by MVP
  • Live 1xBet odds and click-through links on every MVP Event
  • 1xBet-branded previews and betting content
  • Design and content agreed in advance with 1xBet
08

MVP Digital & Video Content

  • Pre-event: press conferences, weigh-ins, face-offs, promos, fighter media-day cutdowns
  • During event: rapid-turn highlight cutdowns
  • Post-event: official photos and recap videos
  • Usable across 1xBet-owned channels, subject to agreed rules
  • Content access applies to all MVP Events across the Term
09

Watch & Bet Streaming

  • Non-exclusive live event Watch & Bet rights for the Term — live event stream for distribution on 1xBet platforms, via MVP
10

Athlete Ambassador Program

  • Three (3) MVP fighters for the term to serve as 1xBet ambassadors - fighters to be agreed 
  • Roles agreed with MVP — content, fight-kit logo and appearances
11

VIP Hospitality & Access 

  • Ten (10) VIP tickets 
  • Ten (10) GA tickets
  • Optional extras: on-stage meet and greet at weigh-ins; backstage tour on fight night; access to press conferences and face-offs 
12

MERCH ACTIVATION POT

  • $5,000 to be used for co-branded merch, each year
13

Account Management

  • A dedicated MVP Account Director for the Term
